game.title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder
game.blurb: Platform game set in the Flower Kingdom, from Nintendo, released 2023-10-20 on Nintendo Switch. RAWG has no playtime yet. Genre: Adventure. Chapters follow the world names on the StrategyWiki contents page.

chapters.title: Pipe-Rock Plateau
chapters.summary: The first world, from Welcome to the Flower Kingdom! to the Pipe-Rock Plateau Palace, plus its Badge Challenges and Wiggler Race.

chapters.title: Fluff-Puff Peaks
chapters.summary: From Outmaway Valley to the Flying Battleship and the Fluff-Puff Peaks Palace.

chapters.title: Shining Falls
chapters.summary: The trial courses, from The Hoppycat Trial to The Final Trial: Zip Track Dash.

chapters.title: Petal Isles and Castle Bowser
chapters.summary: The Petal Isles courses and Flying Battleship, then the Castle Bowser stages. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: The Special World
chapters.summary: The Special courses for every world and the Final Tests.

chapters.title: Sunbaked Desert
chapters.summary: From Armads on the Roll to the Sunbaked Desert Palace.

chapters.title: Fungi Mines
chapters.summary: From Upshroom Downshroom to the three Uncharted Areas.

chapters.title: Deep Magma Bog
chapters.summary: From Where the Rrrumblas Rule to the Flying Battleship and the Deep Magma Bog Palace.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Nintendo Switch only, so no Steam achievements. StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); only its Controls and Table of Contents subpages are written. The contents page lists about 120 world and course pages (none written yet); the chapters use those world names only, no text copied. Chapters keep the order of the StrategyWiki contents page, which puts Shining Falls, Petal Isles with Castle Bowser and the Special World before Sunbaked Desert, Fungi Mines and Deep Magma Bog, so the real play order needs checking. Its categories also list Nintendo Switch 2 and 2026, and mario.fandom.com links a "Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Meetup in Bellabel Park" page; the year here follows RAWG (2023-10-20). mario.fandom.com answers the API with 500 linked articles (the most the API returns in one call), including every world and course name; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
